meta.project: AI Business Assistant - Universal Voice Agent Booking System

product_overview: AI Business Assistant is an intelligent voice agent system that automates appointment booking, order taking, and customer service calls for businesses using real-time AI powered by OpenAI, integrated with Google Calendar and comprehensive analytics.
core_goals: Increase booking conversion rate with 24/7 availability
Improve customer experience through instant, natural AI responses
Automate calendar management and confirmation communications
Provide actionable insights via analytics and call logs
key_features: AI Voice Agent with real-time speech-to-text, natural language understanding, and voice responses using OpenAI Realtime API and WebRTC
Complete Booking Management system with calendar and list views, booking CRUD, pricing calculation, availability checks, and rescheduling
Call History and Transcript Management capturing call logs, outcomes, searchable transcripts, and call analytics
Comprehensive Analytics Dashboard showing revenue, bookings, call performance, and customer insights with charts and exports
Business Settings for configuring business info, services, scheduling, AI assistant personality, knowledge base, and notification integrations
User Authentication and Account Management with secure sign-in, password reset, profile settings, and session management
Integration with Google Calendar for calendar sync and event management
Service Extraction and Knowledge Base management leveraging AI for content extraction and summarization
user_flow_summary: Customer interacts with AI voice agent via web demo or phone call to inquire services and book appointments
AI performs natural conversation, checks availability, confirms booking, saves to database and syncs with Google Calendar
Business owner logs in to manage bookings, filter status, view details, and export reports
Owner configures AI assistant settings including knowledge base content, system instructions, and voice personalities
Owner connects and authorizes Google Calendar integration to enable calendar syncing and notifications
validation_criteria: Successful execution of real-time AI voice conversations with response latency under 500ms
Booking creation accurately reflected in database and Google Calendar
Call logs and transcripts stored and searchable with proper outcome classification
Analytics display correct metrics with proper filtering and export functionality
Authentication workflows complete with secure session management
Configuration changes in business settings persist and apply to AI assistant behavior
Google Calendar OAuth flow completes and tokens stored securely
System scales under expected load with zero missed calls and maintains 90%+ booking completion rate
